description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv. 
 
 We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
 
 
 Job Title 
Android Application Framework Developer - Device Engineering 
 
 About Your Role 
 Kickstart your engineering career at the intersection of Android software and physical hardware! Clover is a global leader in point-of-sale (POS) platforms, powering millions of small businesses worldwide with smart terminals and integrated payment solutions.
We are looking for an Associate Android Application Framework & Device Systems Engineer to join our Device Engineering team in Sunnyvale, CA. In this role, you won't just be building standard mobile screens—you will bridge the gap between high-level Android services and physical hardware peripherals (thermal printers, barcode scanners, cash drawers, scales, and payment modules).
If you are a recent graduate or early-career engineer eager to dive deep into the Android OS, manage USB/network hardware protocols, and see your code drive physical smart terminal hardware used by millions of merchants daily, this is the team for you.

 What You Will Do 
 Hardware-Connected Android Services: Develop Android application framework services and background daemons in Kotlin and Java that interface directly with external hardware and microcontrollers. 
 Peripheral SDK & Hardware Integration: Integrate third-party vendor SDKs and write communication pipelines for POS peripherals, including receipt printers, barcode scanners, cash drawers, and weight scales. 
 USB & Network Protocol Management: Utilize Android USB Host (OTG) APIs to manage hardware attach/detach lifecycle events, configure dynamic USB permissions, and implement socket programming for network IP printers. 
 System & Device Troubleshooting: Use command-line tools ( adb , Logcat, packet/serial sniffers) to isolate, reproduce, and debug hardware integration bugs and OS regressions across our terminal fleet. 
 AOSP & Platform Exposure: Collaborate with senior engineers to explore Android Open Source Project (AOSP) internals, framework extensions, and custom device services. 
 AI-Assisted Engineering: Leverage modern AI-assisted engineering tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and coding agents) to accelerate development, refactor framework code, and optimize debugging workflows. 
 
 What You Need to Have 
 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical & Computer Engineering (ECE), Computer Science, or a related discipline (Graduating seniors or recent grads welcome). 
 Hardware/Device Project Experience: Demonstrated classroom, capstone, research lab, or personal project experience building software that talks to physical devices or external hardware (e.g., IoT devices, Arduino/Raspberry Pi, robotics, microcontrollers, USB accessories, or sensor integration). 
 Core Languages: Strong foundational coding skills in Java or Kotlin , with working knowledge or academic exposure to C or C++ . 
 Android Fundamentals: Practical understanding of native Android development fundamentals (Activities, Services, BroadcastReceivers, Intents, and background threading). 
 Networking & Hardware Protocols: Academic or practical familiarity with low-level communication concepts such as TCP/UDP socket programming, USB device communication (Host/OTG), or serial/UART protocols . 
 CS & Systems Foundations: Rock-solid grasp of core computer science fundamentals: Object-Oriented Design, Data Structures, Operating Systems (threading, processes, memory management), and Git version control. 
 Eagerness to Learn: High curiosity, passion for device hardware, and excitement to learn POS platform architecture and payment security standards. 
 
 Experience that would be great to have: 
 Familiarity with the Android USB Host API ( android.hardware.usb ) or managing hardware permissions and USB intent filters. 
 Coursework or project exposure to the Android Open Source Project (AOSP) or building custom Android ROMs/firmware. 
 Hands-on experience integrating third-party vendor hardware SDKs or libraries. 
 Exposure to low-level microcontroller communication (SPI, I2C, UART) or embedded Linux environments. 
 
 How you’ll work: 
 This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity. 
 This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment. 
 
 Sponsorship: 
 You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role. 
   
 Benefits at Fiserv: 
 Fuel Your Life program to support your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being 
 Paid holidays and generous time away policies 
 No-cost mental health support through Employee Assistance Programs 
 Living Proof program to recognize your peers’ extra effort with points redeemable for rewards 
 Eight Employee Resource Groups to foster a collaborative culture and expand your network 
 ·Unparalleled professional growth with training, development, and internal mobility opportunities 
 Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance options available from day one 
 Retirement planning and discounted shares with the Employee Stock Purchase Plan 
 Tuition assistance and reimbursement program 
 Paid parental, caregiver, and military leave 
 
 #LI-SH2
 
 
 Salary Range 
$124,000.00 - $186,000.00 
 
 These pay ranges apply to employees in Sunnyvale, California. Pay ranges for employees in other states may differ. 
 
 It is unlawful to discriminate against a prospective employee due to the individual's status as a veteran. 
 
 
 
This position is not eligible for an annual incentive opportunity and is also not eligible to earn commissions. 
 
 Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv.  Please: 
 
 Apply using your legal name 
 Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable). 
 
 
 Our commitment to Equal Opportunity: 
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. 
 
 If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation in completing a job application or otherwise participating in the overall hiring process, please contact  AskHR.US@fiserv.com . Please note our AskHR representatives do not have visibility to your application status. Current associates who require a workplace accommodation should refer to Fiserv’s Disability Accommodation Policy for additional information.
 
 Note to agencies: 
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
 
 Warning about fake job posts: 
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.
